title: Models
subtitle: Nothing downloads on its own. Grab what you need, remove it anytime.
noneInstalled: No model installed — install one or this feature won't work.

badge.exclusiveTip: SAMURAI and SAM2Long each replace the SAM 2 engine with their own: only one can be installed at a time. Installing the second asks for confirmation first, then removes the first; deleting it restores the original engine.

conflict.title: Only one at a time
conflict.body: {{model}} replaces the engine of {{other}}, which is already installed: the two can't coexist. Installing {{model}} removes {{other}}.

vramShort: Needs {{need}} GB of VRAM, your card has {{have}} ({{gpu}}) — it won't fit. You can still download it.

status.bundledTip: Included in the runtime (can't be removed).
status.autoTip: Fetched by the library on first use — nothing to download.

action.resumeTip: Incomplete download — picks up the missing weights and code.

search.useTip: Make this variant the search model
search.switchEmpty: {{model}} has indexed nothing yet: search stays empty until a full re-index. The current variant keeps its index on disk, untouched.
search.switchPartial: Clips already indexed with {{model}}: {{clips}}. The rest will need a re-index; the current variant keeps its index on disk.

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.tip: Show the whole catalog: variants, earlier generations and experimental engines. By default only each task's current selection is shown.

catalogHint.siglip2-giant: The most accurate, and the heaviest.
catalogHint.face-real: Real faces: finds them and recognizes who it is. Needed for face search.
catalogHint.face-anime: Anime faces: finds them and recognizes who it is. Downloads on first use.
catalogHint.whisper-large-v3: The best transcription, and the slowest.
catalogHint.nemotron-3.5-asr: 40 languages, automatic punctuation and capitals. Needs transcribe-cli, installed by hand.
catalogHint.silero-vad: Detects speech to start and stop dictation. Fast, runs on the CPU.
